      public boolean verify(byte[] content, byte[] signature, PublicKey certificatePublicKey)
      Description copied from interface: SignatureAlgorithm
      Verifies a signature over the given content with the given public key. Note that this does not check that the public key matches this signature scheme; use SignatureAlgorithm.keyMatchesScheme(PublicKey) for that.

      Parameters:
